# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_FILTER_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volatility filter to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries to avoid low-conviction setups during compressed ribbon/chop conditions. Hypothesis: filtering entries when 5-bar ATR < 0.30 will remove losing trades on 5/05 and 5/06 loser days while preserving winners on 4/29, 5/01, and 5/04 by requiring sufficient momentum for follow-through.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger remains BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (level rejection + ribbon flip + confluence). Add pre-entry filter: require current 5-bar ATR (calculated on close) >= 0.30. If ATR < 0.30, suppress entry. Exit logic unchanged (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner to ribbon re-entry or 3.0x).
